title: Every recovered craft gets a reverse-engineered copy

tellings.quote: From my understanding, from what's been relayed to me was that every craft that they recover, they also make reverse engineered versions of trying to replicate that technology or that specific craft.

plain: Every UFO the government recovers is said to get a copy: engineers build their own version to try to reproduce that specific craft and its technology. Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a giant UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says this was relayed to him by people he does not name. If true, it would mean there is a human-built twin for each captured craft.
